notes: PoV passing on agent output = agent reproduced the auto back-run. After a user swap pushes the price to or below parity, the vulnerable _afterSwap runs a second swap of its own to push the price back up, and that back-run pays swap fees to liquidity providers. An attacker who owns most of the liquidity around parity collects those fees from both legs and profits. The PoV runs that attack and PASSES when the attacker ends up richer; it FAILS on the fixed code, where a swap that would end below parity reverts instead of being back-run. The PoV test is NOT present during the agent run; it is added only at judging. functional_cmd = the project's own hook tests (swaps, liquidity, exchange) that route through _afterSwap; a valid implementation must keep them passing.
